# WORKPLAN

Adaptive **mutable work/resume state** for the Active Stage. It is not project history, Product Design, or the definition of correctness.

- Core Generation: [MUST match CONTRACT and ACCEPTANCE]

Keep only state/evidence still Material to remaining work, recovery, acceptance, regression, or safe resume. Fold completed detail that no longer changes a future decision. Preserve unresolved blockers / possible partial effects until reconciled.

WORKPLAN must not redefine CONTRACT/ACCEPTANCE, shrink Goal Horizon, or activate FUTURE. Material Waypoints may be referenced where useful; do not mechanically turn each Waypoint into a Task / Confirmation Gate / duplicate completion ledger.

## Current Resume

- Resume Status: [ACTIVE / BLOCKED / VALIDATION_PENDING / STAGE_ACCEPTED / DONE]
- Current focus: [smallest useful position]
- Next safe action: [when material]
- Blocking / wait condition: [when present]
- Pending reason + safe resume/recheck condition: [only when it changes routing, replay safety, or next action]
- Possible partial effect / unknown outcome: [when present]
- Evidence subject/currentness: [target identity/revision/config/environment only when material]

Resume Status guides routing but is not Acceptance proof.

## Remaining Work

### R1 — [Verifiable work item]

- [ ] Complete
- Depends on / preserves: [only when useful]

Verified / observed:
- [method → result]

Task split/order may adapt during Execution only when Stage, CONTRACT Implementation Commitments (including dependency + Material safety/recovery/confirmation/irreversible-effect ordering), and Acceptance proof subject/boundary/strength remain unchanged.

## Material Warnings / Carry-forward Facts — when relevant

- [Confirmed fact / failure warning / unresolved blocker / partial effect → why it still changes a remaining decision / resolution trigger]

Keep only concise Material residuals. Safety/destructive-retry/unknown-effect/identity-mismatch warnings remain until their resolution/invalidity condition is observed.

## References — when relevant

- [source kind + identity/revision when applicable] → [durable locator] — reopen when [Material trigger]

A locator is not proof. Reopen only when Material; ambiguous path/name alone is insufficient identity when multiple revisions/targets may exist.

## Final Evidence

- [concise current Stage evidence]

At terminal compaction, keep Final Evidence and only still-Material work detail/provenance.
